summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests STRO-006, an antibody drug conjugate that targets integrin beta-6, alone and with pembrolizumab, in adults with refractory recurrent or metastatic solid tumors. STRO-006 is given by intravenous infusion, and the record does not state how long or how often. The study looks at safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body, and early anti-tumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa STRO-006, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco que se dirige a la integrina beta-6, solo y junto con pembrolizumab, en adultos con tumores sólidos refractarios, recurrentes o metastásicos. STRO-006 se administra por infusión intravenosa; el registro no indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se distribuye el fármaco en el organismo y la actividad antitumoral temprana.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with refractory recurrent or metastatic solid tumors of the listed types
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Prior treatment with an ADC that has a TOP1 inhibitor payload
Chemotherapy within 2 weeks or immunotherapy within 3 weeks before first dose
Untreated or active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease
Active interstitial lung disease, or active or recent pneumonitis within 6 months
Concurrent participation in another therapeutic treatment trial
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
